note: Real archive records reused from Finna (finna.fi). All images are Public Domain Mark 1.0 or CC0 1.0 as stated by the holding institutions. Finnish titles and descriptions come from Finna; English versions are translations by the kit. Map points are approximate (street or town level) and added by the kit.

en.title: Demo Archive
en.summary: A sample archive showcasing Omeka S Finland Kit with freely reusable photographs from Finnish museums.

en: Streets, squares and trams in Helsinki from the 1930s to the 1970s.
Factories, haymaking, log driving and household work.
Song festivals, dance pavilions, winter outings and urban culture.
